assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and unexplained syncope, raising concern for underlying arrhythmia in the context of known sick sinus syndrome.
The patient has a diagnosis of sick sinus syndrome coded as I49.5.
A cardiac event monitoring study is ordered to correlate intermittent symptoms with cardiac rhythm disturbances for further diagnostic evaluation.
The cardiac event monitoring study is coded with CPT 93271.
The service is supported by the documented symptoms of dizziness coded as R42.
The service is supported by the documented symptoms of syncope coded as R55.
The service demonstrates distinct service provision beyond any bundled procedure.
